---
name: Pull Request
about: Create a pull request to contribute to this project
title: "[feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor]: "
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style changes (formatting, no code change)
- [ ] 🔧 Refactor (code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the existing style conventions
- [ ] **Linting passes:** `ruff check src tests` is clean
- [ ] **Tests pass:** `pytest` runs successfully
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
- [ ] I have tested the changes manually (if applicable)

## Testing
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] CI pipeline is green
- [ ] Manual testing completed

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots here to help reviewers understand the UI changes.

## Related Issues
Closes # (issue number)

## Additional Notes
Any other information or context that would be helpful for reviewers.
